family.description: This domain found in a group of sequences from fungi and plants, including Gag1 from Saccharomyces cerevisiae, which interacts with Cka2, the fourth subunit of the eukaryotic kinase CK2. Gag1 is organised into three domains: lock, Gag and Clap (this entry). This domain has three regions: rear, hinge and front [[cite:PUB00153176]]. It contains two conserved sequence motifs: IPL and FLVD.
family.name: Gag1-like, clamp domain
